made pattern meeting another second form.object: A count handed over at a meeting of two made patterns: through a start knot under the recorded ordinary count with the recorded taking rule, and through a knot the growth made under a take of a sole candidate with an owing ration
made pattern meeting another second form.outcome: Ticket A: the first join receives 2 + M fresh distinctions in every numbering (M the second pattern's births that round); courses separate exactly where M differs; link a start knot. Ticket B: 88 pairs per knot law meet only through a made knot both descend from (FLOOR1, waiting, sole take); under the owing ration 280 pairs per knot law have a course that differs with the second part barred, attribution accepted, m = 1, the barred run having no meeting. Nothing composed over several births; no pattern responds to which pattern it meets.

made pattern meeting another second form.object: A made count of returns: a second part whose own knots number a fixed count for each tick of a made clock and stop when the clock is barred (C), and the weaker reading that its course differs at each of three returns (C-iii)
made pattern meeting another second form.outcome: No made count: C fails in all 88,299 tests, each decided. Under the two primary laws no clock gives parts off at four ticks. C-iii holds in 78 tests (8 under STEPS-1, 20 under STEPS-2 for offshoots of joins, 50 under STEPS-2; 148 undecided), all under rules that choose by name; none survives every numbering of its start (80 of 240; 112 of 240). 25 knots fail the knot test, all joins under parity. Neither side of the filed stop reached.

made pattern meeting another second form.object: One part's course differing with another part stopped, under laws in which a birth takes a distinction none of its parents holds
made pattern meeting another second form.outcome: 216 confirmed through a meeting made by births (180 through a knot the growth made, 36 through a start knot); in 62 an ancestral common knot is among the links, always a start knot; in 72 a joint birth follows; none depends on what the other part is. The cheapest law looks two holder steps out and uses no record of descent. No case survives a change of its ration on its own start.

made pattern meeting another second form.outcome: Theorem K* and Lemma P proved (refereed, confirmed with fixes, no Block); the 12 descriptions with an unexposed dependence, 5 distinct patterns, bounded at 5 at every depth (2 patterns by orbit-and-block bonds, 3 by stem bonds of depth 2) with no two-orbit bond from level 3 at every distance, so Conjecture C' is false; the 13 mutants of 8db5da810c00, 5 patterns: L_11(3,5) = L_11(3,6) = 6 (no bond of at most 5, LRAT; stem bonds of 6 at every depth), no stem bond of at most 8 from s = 7 (none of any size for -73 at s = 7, the referee's product test), and one pattern (-73 = -79) exactly 7 at s = 7, 8 at depth 12 (LRAT); growth open; Conjecture C* stated

made pattern meeting another second form.object: Nesting with shared lists: copies meet every distinction their ancestors enlisted, through uniform list knots
made pattern meeting another second form.outcome: Finite-state: life depends on lists only through capped value counts, so eventually periodic in depth and decided in the limit; narrows NEST-COUNT's interface-size reading

made pattern meeting another second form.object: What survives a paid newborn orientation into a continuing receiver
made pattern meeting another second form.outcome: Both orientations remain possible in every such bank. The first child already holds the paid name. An incident second child's single fresh bit guesses it correctly on 25/49 under equally weighted earlier words, but the earlier three focal names are already spent. The true three-parent sibling receiver's own bit gives 130313/259308 under that weighting. Its six older parental inputs plus the later fresh values admit all fourteen original words.

first part course differs with what seco.outcome: 75 of 240 tree starts and 32 of 240 augmented tree starts funded a first cohort. In 307 continuing parity steps and 321 not-all-equal steps no witnessed whole part split or merged. No generator frequency estimated.

first part course differs with what seco.object: Whether parts of the live roster that share nothing can become one part again under laws in which a birth takes a distinction that is already shared
first part course differs with what seco.outcome: Never: no two parts that share nothing are one part again and no birth has a parent in each (an argument: everything a birth takes is held by one of its parents). From round 1 these rules undo both objects.

two descendant parts same form both pare.object: Which small starts come to hold a part that copies itself, and which rations and treatments allow copying
two descendant parts same form both pare.outcome: 85 to 97 percent of starts under FLOOR1 (lower bounds); no copying under the ordinary count, caps or a fixed two; a five-member copier under a fixed three; sevens and nines under a fixed four; fillers stop everything by round 3; holding with waiting jams

two descendant parts same form both pare.object: Distance to a later common output
two descendant parts same form both pare.outcome: Inclusive distance falls by exactly one until overlap. Pure-to-inclusive distance cannot fall. Separate growing parts remain independent by parentage.

two descendant parts same form both pare.object: Physical controls linking two already surviving products
two descendant parts same form both pare.outcome: One shared distinction is sufficient to turn separate witnessed parts into a later common birth while keeping both products. A single loose distinction on the one-ended comparison adds a new joint descendant at size d+3.

two descendant parts same form both pare.object: Whether the part that returns is made of knots that waited
two descendant parts same form both pare.outcome: Every return of a ring itself is made of knots that waited; the pattern half a period later is made of new knots; small parts return with no waiting. The prediction that everything returning waited failed

two descendant parts same form both pare.object: Two weighted panels of delayed ancestry
two descendant parts same form both pare.outcome: 66/240 and 31/240 initial steps funded. Common descendants within the observation window in 140/1634 tree and 95/970 augmented-tree episodes; zero delayed pure co-parent receipts in the initially separated panel.

two descendant parts same form both pare.object: Small parts of the live roster that copy themselves under floor rations with a cancelling treatment
two descendant parts same form both pare.outcome: A two-member part returns beside a copy of itself every two rounds; under FLOOR0 with offshoots the members number five times the Fibonacci numbers in separate parts; found in a swap table, not studied
